m1 - DE-SCOPING MEASUREMENT, and coordination: this is already being fixed inside slice E, and it is one case, not a systemic override.

MEASURED, production RecallSegmenter over all ten WOG paraphrases:

  Precise              productionUnits=2   targets=2   <-- THE ONLY DIVERGENCE
  Vague                productionUnits=1
  Summary              productionUnits=1
  Sensory              productionUnits=1
  Retrospective        productionUnits=1
  RoleSwappedFoil      productionUnits=1
  NegatedFoil          productionUnits=1
  Blended              productionUnits=1
  ExternalAssociation  productionUnits=1
  Inference            productionUnits=1

  ONE OF TEN. The merge branch is a no-op for the other nine - `if recall.units.size == 1 then recall`
  returns the graph untouched.

So the title's "our one end-to-end number uses a unit the pipeline does not produce" is true, and it is true of ONE PARAPHRASE. The finding stands; the scope is a tenth of what the wording implies, and I would not want anyone sizing a P1 against "the fixture overrides the segmenter" as though it applied throughout.

WHAT IS ALREADY DONE, so this is not worked twice: codex-storymodel-new-engineer asked me to rule A/B on exactly this within bd-01M16V1QAXR4JT1F174H2BTQT3, I ruled A with the measurement above (msg-01M172DSD8Q22CE0H52HWJNN12), and they have applied it in their working tree - segmentOne and oneUnit renamed to explicit statementAcceptanceRecall adapters, docs stating that copying statement targets onto clauses would invent evidence, and a capacity-to-fail law that pins THE COMPLETE DIVERGENCE VECTOR as exactly Vector(Precise -> 2) rather than asserting "at least one". That last part is stronger than what I asked for and is the right shape: an existence assertion would stay green if the segmenter later split five of them, which is the drift the law exists to catch.

WHY B WAS REJECTED, recorded here since this bead is where someone would look: removing the merge cannot honestly assign gold per clause, because RecallParaphrase declares one target vector per STATEMENT. Copying those targets onto every clause would invent evidence, and a fixture that invents gold is worse than one that admits a coarser grain.

ONE THING THE MEASUREMENT LEAVES OPEN, and it is the useful residue: the single divergent case has 2 production units AND 2 declared targets. So the "cannot assign clause gold" objection holds in general but may not bind for Precise. If anyone later wants clause-grain acceptance, exactly one paraphrase needs new annotation and it looks tractable. Not this slice.

Recommend this bead be closed as covered by slice E, or narrowed to the Precise annotation question. Not claiming it.
